newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh Jan-Aug trade surplus widens to $1.19 bln.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Jan-Aug trade surplus widens to $1.19 bln.

text.p: Kazakhstan posted a trade surplus of $1.19 billion in the first eight months of this year after a $650.3 million surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said.
In August the trade surplus narrowed to $66.4 million from $160.3 million in July.
KAZAKH MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Aug 96 Jan-Jul 96 Jan-Aug 95
KAZAKH MERCHANDISE TRADE Aug 96 Jul 96 Aug 95

Notes -- Figures in million dollars, FOB. Data are for trade with foreign countries, excluding former Soviet states and imports by small private traders. Including trade with former Soviet republics, the surplus widened to $1.49 billion from $899.8 million in January-August last year.
The Committee said trade with the rest of the CIS accounted for more than 60 percent of total trade in the first eight months of this year.
